summary: Targeted five load-bearing claims from brief.md for counter-evidence: (A) the implied 'smooth, low-friction' print/assembly build resting on a single experienced builder's account with a named, unexploited search-coverage gap (forum/Reddit/video build logs); (B) the 'no heat-set inserts needed' mechanical-reliability claim, singly-corroborated; (C) the official ~34hr print / ~2hr assembly time estimates, vendor-sourced only; (D) the single-sourced motor-ID (7/8/9) assignment pitfall not confirmed by the primary Assembly.md; and (E) a narrow, in-bounds check of whether real-world total spend exceeds the $482-499 reference BOM baseline (shipping/tariffs/reprints), without re-litigating the already out-of-bounds four-way cost reconciliation. Each has search angles, non-vendor-source preferences, and honesty-in-reporting criteria to avoid manufacturing false balance.
